title: Does a Frog Drink Water? Frog Explained Simply | PUC Biology Class 11
description:
After the rain, Diya picks up a frog at a pond. Its skin is cool and slippery. Does a frog drink water? And what inside it lets it live in water and on land?

You will meet Rana tigrina, a cold-blooded animal that uses camouflage, aestivation and hibernation, then zoom from the whole frog to its head (nostrils, eyes, nictitating membrane, tympanum) and its moist skin. We build the limbs and sexual dimorphism step by step, follow a meal through the gut, see how a frog breathes in water and on land, its three-chambered heart and its kidneys, with a pause and think. Then a worked example on the three parts of the brain, the exam trap about fertilisation, an original NEET pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

This is Episode 58 of our PUC Biology series.

Made for NCERT, CBSE, ISC (CISCE), PUC (Karnataka) and NEET students.

In this video:
